strings.en: "This puzzle is a game where you put 15 jumbled-up panels back in order!"{n}"There's one spot with a panel missing, so into that spot..."{n}{n}"Pick a panel above, below, left or right of it with the Control Pad, and slide it with the A Button!"{n}"If you wanna give up, press the Y Button!"{n}{n}"The time limit is 5 minutes! The faster you finish, the higher your score!"

strings.jp: 「…………と 言っても{n} 説明することも ないし{n} とにかく やってみてよ」
strings.en: "..........Well, there's nothing{n} to explain, really.{n} Just give it a try!"

strings.jp: 「じゃあ これ景品だよ!」{n}{n}
strings.en: "Here, this is your prize!"{n}{n}
